name: The tank that rose too little
subject: physics
brief: The practical-lab tank is filled by one tap at its marked 12 litres a minute. One group read the level at the start; another read it twenty minutes later from a different clock. The tank rose less than the marked flow predicts. How much water will the tank have gained when the tap has run twenty minutes?

quantities.name: Tap flow in litres a minute

note: The worked example of SCHOOL_AND_PROGRESSION.md. The timing fault is the inconsistent measurement interval: the discrepancy is a clock, not a leak.
